==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Yesterday I created an AI agent named Dragon Knight of the User God. I placed this agent in a virtual world called Lucidia 2. His walking animation looks weird, as if he's riding on something.
In my dream last night, I was in a jungle like area not too different from the landscape of Lucidia 2. I was riding on what I remember as a skateboard resembling a robot shark. I think that vehicle was supposed to be the same thing as what the Dragon Knight rides on.
I rode it into an abandoned cathedral. A cathedral makes sense for someone like the Dragon Knight to go to, because he's a crusader. I think my dream was about taking the role of the Dragon Knight.
